payload.claim: This comment labels the justification for PUSH_TIMEOUT_S as 'Measured' and cites the 1.3-1.4s dry-run push time, but 120 is not that measured number — it is a reasoned ~90x margin on top of it (per the spec's own notes). CLAUDE.md says a comment must say whether a value is measured or reasoned; unlike the analogous WALL_SECONDS_PER_TURN comment in saffron/cell/session.py:79, which states its multiplier explicitly ('about 1.4 times the slowest...'), this comment never states the multiplier or that 120 itself is a reasoned margin, so a reader cannot tell why 120 rather than some other number was chosen from the comment alone.
